**Finding: compliant** (no redline proposed)

The Agreement contains no audit right against us. Literal searches for "audit", "inspect", "records" and "verif" all returned zero hits, and a complete read of the document (a single section, p0000–p0074) confirms it — the fees provision (p0023) and the Use of Service covenants (p0025) impose payment and compliance obligations but no inspection, verification or books-and-records right.

The only access language, in p0001, is operational cooperation so that Kubient can deliver the Services; it is not a usage-audit right and grants no direct or remote access to our systems. Since we are subject to no audit obligation at all, we sit better than the AUDIT preferred position (annual, 30 days' notice, independent auditor, Vendor's cost, no system access), so there is nothing to constrain and flagging it would only invite the Vendor to insert a right it never asked for.

One note for the negotiation record rather than a redline: the revenue share in p0023 turns on Impressions "as measured by Kubient" (p0009). That is a one-sided measurement basis, and we may separately wish to seek audit/verification rights *against the Vendor's* reporting — a customer-favourable addition that falls outside this rule's scope.
